literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day gengshen, he visited the ancestral tombs.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on gengshen day, he paid homage at the ancestral tombs.

literal: On day wuchen, he returned to the capital and visited Emperor Taizu's temple.
idiomatic: On wuchen day he returned to the capital and visited Emperor Taizu's temple.

literal: On day xinwei, Yan subjects who had resumed their livelihoods reported affairs at Bianzhou.
idiomatic: On xinwei day Yan people who had returned to their occupations reported on conditions at Bianzhou.

literal: On day guiyou, the Jurchen tribes came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On guiyou day the Jurchen tribes brought tribute.

literal: On day guiwei, Uighur envoys were granted clothing in varying measure.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Uighur envoys were given robes in varying measure.

literal: In the fifth month, on day wuxu, he took the summer retreat along Lake Yanliu.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuxu day, he passed the summer at Lake Yanliu.

literal: On the wuwu new moon of the sixth month, the Bigide came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon of the sixth month the Bigide came with tribute.

literal: On day yiyou, the Tuyuhun came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the Tuyuhun brought tribute.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day xinmao, the Ugu came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On xinmao day in the seventh autumn month the Ugu came with tribute.

literal: On day renchen, Princess Puge(?) led the Sanhe Ugu to court.
idiomatic: On renchen day Princess Puge(?) led the Sanhe Ugu to court.

literal: On day bingshen, Shi Jingtang, Tang's military governor of Hedong, was attacked by his sovereign and sent Zhao Ying through Southwest Route Pacification Commissioner Lu Bugu to beg for aid; the Emperor reported to the Empress Dowager, saying, "Li Congke murdered his lord and installed himself — gods and men alike are enraged; heaven's punishment should be carried out.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Shi Jingtang, Tang's governor of Hedong, was attacked by his sovereign and sent Zhao Ying through the Southwest Route Pacification Commissioner Lu Bugu to plead for help. The Emperor told the Empress Dowager, "Li Congke murdered his lord and seized the throne — heaven and earth are both enraged; he deserves heaven's punishment.

literal: " At that time Zhao Dejun also sent envoys, and Hedong again sent Sang Weihan in urgent appeal; troops were accordingly authorized.
idiomatic: " At the same time Zhao Dejun sent envoys as well, and Hedong dispatched Sang Weihan again in desperate appeal; the court agreed to raise an army.

literal: In the eighth month, on day jiwei, Xiao Gelili was dispatched to report the campaign schedule to Hedong.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiwei day, Xiao Gelili was sent to notify Hedong of the army's timetable.

literal: On day bingyin, the Tuyuhun came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the Tuyuhun brought tribute.

literal: On day gengwu, he personally led troops to relieve Jingtang.
idiomatic: On gengwu day he personally took the field to rescue Jingtang.

literal: In the ninth month, on day guisi, a flying scarlet bird fell from the sky dead; Yilizhen Halu En of the Southern Prefecture obtained it and presented it.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi day, a scarlet bird fell dead from the sky; Yilizhen Halu En of the Southern Prefecture found it and presented it to the throne.

literal: Divination was performed — auspicious.
idiomatic: When divination was performed, the omen was auspicious.

literal: The Emperor said, "This is a sign that Congke will destroy himself!
idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is a sign that Congke will bring about his own ruin!

literal: " On day dingyou, he entered Yanmen.
idiomatic: " On dingyou day he entered Yanmen Pass.

literal: On day wuxu, he halted at Xinzhou and sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On wuxu day he encamped at Xinzhou and offered sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

literal: On day jihai, he halted at Taiyuan.
idiomatic: On jihai day he encamped at Taiyuan.

literal: On day gengzi, he sent envoys to tell Jingtang, "I have raised an army and come from afar; I shall at once join you in breaking the enemy.
idiomatic: On gengzi day he sent envoys to tell Jingtang, "I have marched three thousand li to reach you; I will join you at once in crushing the enemy.

literal: " Tang generals Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing came with troops to resist, so he drew up his army in battle order before Taiyuan.
idiomatic: " Tang generals Gao Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing advanced to oppose him, and he drew up his army in battle order before Taiyuan.

literal: When battle was joined, he feigned retreat.
idiomatic: When battle was joined, he feigned a retreat.

literal: Tang generals Zhang Jingda and Yang Guangyuan also formed battle lines to the west; before their ranks were complete, he pressed them with troops.
idiomatic: Tang generals Zhang Jingda and Yang Guangyuan also drew up to the west; before their lines were fully formed, he pressed them hard.

literal: Meanwhile Xingzhou and Yanqing were cut off by ambush troops and could not rescue one another, head and tail alike.
idiomatic: Meanwhile Xingzhou and Yanqing were cut off by hidden troops and could not aid each other — head and tail alike were stranded.

literal: Jingda and Guangyuan were utterly defeated; discarded weapons piled like hills, and tens of thousands of heads were taken.
idiomatic: Jingda and Guangyuan were routed utterly; discarded weapons piled like hills, and tens of thousands of heads were taken.

literal: Jingda fled to hold Jin'an Stockade; Yilizhen Dilu fought him and died in battle.
idiomatic: Jingda fled to hold Jin'an Stockade; Yilizhen Dilu fought him and fell in battle.

literal: Jingtang led his officials to an audience; the Emperor took his hand and comforted him.
idiomatic: Jingtang came with his officials to pay homage; the Emperor took his hand and comforted him.

literal: On day guimao, Jin'an was besieged.
idiomatic: On guimao day Jin'an was besieged.

literal: On day jiachen, Dilu's son Tuli Gu succeeded as yilizhen, taking his father's style as his name to honor his loyalty.
idiomatic: On jiachen day Dilu's son Tuli Gu succeeded as yilizhen, taking his father's style as his own name to honor his loyalty.

literal: Southern Chancellor Heli Di, Xi Military Supervisor Yinniyou, and General Pei A had shown cowardice and retreated in battle; the Emperor summoned and sharply rebuked them.
idiomatic: Southern Chancellor Heli Di, Xi Military Supervisor Yinniyou, and General Pei A had quailed and fallen back in battle; the Emperor summoned them and rebuked them sharply.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day jiazi, Jingtang was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin, and the Emperor visited his residence.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on jiazi day, Jingtang was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin, and the Emperor visited his residence.

literal: Jingtang and his wife, the Lady Li, led their kin in raising cups to wish him long life.
idiomatic: Jingtang and his wife Lady Li led their kin in raising cups to wish the Emperor long life.

literal: When the siege of Jin'an first began, picked troops were dispatched to hold key points and cut off the routes of relief armies.
idiomatic: When the siege of Jin'an began, picked troops were posted at key points to cut off every route by which relief might arrive.

literal: Li Congke sent Zhao Yanshou with twenty thousand troops to encamp at Tuanbai Valley, and Fan Yanguang with twenty thousand troops to encamp at Liaozhou; Fan Yanguang with twenty thousand troops to encamp at Liaozhou — Yanguang: in the biographical chapter of the New History of the Five Dynasties, fascicle 51, this name is written Yanguang.
idiomatic: Li Congke sent Zhao Yanshou with twenty thousand men to hold Tuanbai Valley and Fan Yanguang with twenty thousand to hold Liaozhou; Fan Yanguang with twenty thousand to hold Liaozhou — Yanguang: in the biographical chapter of the New History of the Five Dynasties, fascicle 51, the name is written Yanguang.

literal: This was changed to avoid the taboo name of Taizong, Deguang.
idiomatic: The text was altered here to avoid the taboo name of Taizong, Deguang.

literal: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou, with more than ten thousand troops under his command, came from Shangdang toward Yanshou's army to join forces and attack.
idiomatic: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou, with more than ten thousand men under his command, marched from Shangdang toward Yanshou's army to combine forces and strike.

literal: Learning that preparations had been made here, all halted and would not advance.
idiomatic: Learning that the enemy was prepared, they all halted and would not advance.

literal: Congke then led thirty thousand picked cavalry out and encamped at Heyang, personally directing the armies.
idiomatic: Congke then led thirty thousand picked cavalry out and encamped at Heyang, personally directing the armies.

literal: Yet knowing no rescue would come, he only drank deeply and sang mournful songs each day.
idiomatic: Yet knowing no rescue would come, he spent his days drinking deep and singing dirges.

literal: On day dingmao, Jingtang was summoned to the imperial camp and granted a seat.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Jingtang was summoned to the imperial camp and given a seat.

literal: The Emperor spoke to him at ease, saying, "I raised an army and came three thousand li; one battle and victory — surely this is heaven's will.
idiomatic: The Emperor spoke to him at ease: "I raised an army and marched three thousand li; one battle and we were victorious — surely this is heaven's will.

literal: Seeing your imposing stature and great capacity, you should receive these southern lands and for generations serve as my frontier vassal and support.
idiomatic: You look imposing and broad in capacity; you should receive these southern lands and for generations serve as my frontier vassal and support.

literal: " He then ordered the officials to set up an altar at Jinyang and prepare the rites of investiture.
idiomatic: " He then ordered officials to set up an altar at Jinyang and prepare the rites of investiture.

literal: In the eleventh month, on day dingyou, Jingtang was invested as Emperor of Great Jin.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingyou day, Jingtang was invested as Emperor of Great Jin.

literal: From day wuxu to day wushen, outriders twice reported troops arriving from the south, then again reported troops arriving from the west.
idiomatic: From wuxu day to wushen day, outriders twice reported troops approaching from the south, then again reported troops approaching from the west.

literal: Again they reported troops arriving from the west — zou (report): the original text read yu (at).
idiomatic: Again they reported troops approaching from the west — zou (report): the original text read yu (at).

literal: According to the Yongle Encyclopedia
idiomatic: According to the Yongle Encyclopedia

literal: (hereafter abbreviated as the Encyclopedia)〉
idiomatic: (hereafter abbreviated as the Encyclopedia)〉

literal: 480, emended.
idiomatic: 480, emended.

literal: Tiyin Dielian Wa was ordered to repel them.
idiomatic: Tiyin Dielian Wa was ordered to repel them.

literal: Tang general Zhang Jingda, besieged for more than eighty days, was cut off within and without; army stores were nearly exhausted, so that horse dung was washed and splintered wood fed to the horses; the horses grew so hungry they ate one another's manes and tails, and when they died their flesh was eaten.
idiomatic: Tang general Zhang Jingda, besieged for more than eighty days, was cut off within and without; army stores were nearly exhausted. They washed horse dung and fed the horses splintered wood; the horses grew so hungry they ate one another's manes and tails, and when they died their flesh was eaten.

literal: Guangyuan and the others urged Jingda to surrender; Jingda said, "I have only death.
idiomatic: Guangyuan and the others urged Jingda to surrender; Jingda said, "I have only death.

literal: If you wish to surrender, you may cut off my head and surrender with it."
idiomatic: If you wish to surrender, cut off my head and surrender with it."

literal: In the intercalary month, on day jiazi, Yang Guangyuan and An Shenqi killed Jingda and surrendered.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiazi day, Yang Guangyuan and An Shenqi killed Jingda and surrendered.

literal: When the Emperor heard that Jingda had remained steadfast unto death, he said to those beside him, "Every subject should be like this!
idiomatic: When the Emperor learned that Jingda had remained steadfast unto death, he said to those beside him, "Every loyal subject should be like this!

literal: " He ordered him buried with full rites.
idiomatic: " He ordered him buried with full rites.

literal: The surrendered soldiers and five thousand horses were bestowed on the Jin Emperor.
idiomatic: The surrendered soldiers and five thousand horses were bestowed on the Jin Emperor.

literal: On day bingyin, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to in announcement of success.
idiomatic: On bingyin day sacrifice was offered to Heaven and Earth to announce success.

literal: On day gengwu, Vice Chancellor Xiao Kuguzhi reported that Zhao Dejun and the other relief armies were about to flee; an edict ordered troops sent out by night in pursuit.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Vice Chancellor Xiao Kuguzhi reported that Zhao Dejun and the other relief armies were about to flee; an edict ordered troops sent out by night in pursuit.

literal: Dejun's army and the others all cast aside weapons and armor, trampling one another; those crushed into ravines and valleys were beyond counting.
idiomatic: Dejun's army and the others cast aside weapons and armor and trampled one another; those crushed into ravines and valleys were beyond counting.

literal: The Crown Prince was further ordered to ride light cavalry to seize strategic points; more than ten thousand foot soldiers were overtaken and all surrendered.
idiomatic: The Crown Prince was further ordered to ride light cavalry to seize the strategic passes; more than ten thousand foot soldiers were overtaken and all surrendered.

literal: On day xinwei, the army crossed Tuanbai Valley and sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with wine and food.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the army crossed Tuanbai Valley and sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with wine and food.

literal: Soon Dejun and his son were overtaken, and they led their followers in surrender.
idiomatic: Soon Dejun and his son were overtaken, and they led their followers in surrender.

literal: Halting at Luzhou, he summoned the generals to counsel; all asked to withdraw the army, and he agreed.
idiomatic: Halting at Luzhou, he summoned the generals to counsel; all urged withdrawal, and he agreed.

literal: Southern Chancellor Jieling, Heli Di, Xi Military Supervisor Yinniyou, and General Pei A were ordered to return first.
idiomatic: Southern Chancellor Jieling, Heli Di, Xi Military Supervisor Yinniyou, and General Pei A were ordered to return first.

literal: On day renshen, Tiyin Wa and Linya Dilbi came to present captives.
idiomatic: On renshen day Tiyin Wa and Linya Dilbi came to present captives.

literal: The Jin Emperor took leave to return; the Emperor feasted and drank with him.
idiomatic: The Jin Emperor took leave to return; the Emperor feasted and drank with him.

literal: When the wine had gone deep, they clasped hands and pledged themselves as father and son.
idiomatic: When the wine had gone deep, they clasped hands and pledged themselves as father and son.

literal: One white sable cloak, twenty stud horses, and twelve hundred war horses were given as a farewell gift.
idiomatic: He gave one white sable cloak, twenty stud horses, and twelve hundred war horses as a farewell gift.

literal: Dilbi was ordered to lead five thousand cavalry to escort him into Luoyang.
idiomatic: Dilbi was ordered to lead five thousand cavalry to escort him into Luoyang.

literal: At parting he said to him, "I remain here until the turmoil is settled, and then I shall return.
idiomatic: At parting he said to him, "I remain here until the turmoil is settled, and then I shall return.

literal: " On day xinsi, the Jin Emperor reached Heyang; Li Congke, in desperate straits, summoned Renhuang Prince Bei to die with him; Bei refused, so he sent men to kill him, then the whole clan burned themselves to death.
idiomatic: " On xinsi day the Jin Emperor reached Heyang. Li Congke, in desperate straits, summoned Renhuang Prince Bei to die with him; Bei refused, so Congke sent men to kill him, then the whole clan burned themselves to death.

literal: An edict ordered the collection and burial on the Fen River of his soldiers who had fallen in battle, as a victory mound.
idiomatic: An edict ordered the soldiers who had fallen in battle collected and buried on the Fen River as a victory mound.

literal: Jin ordered Sang Weihan to compose a text recording the Emperor's merit and virtue.
idiomatic: Jin ordered Sang Weihan to compose a text recording the Emperor's merit and virtue.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou new moon, the personal attendant Talu was dispatched to inquire after the Jin Emperor.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yiyou new moon, the personal attendant Talu was sent to inquire after the Jin Emperor.

literal: On day bingxu, the spoils taken at Jin'an were divided and bestowed on officers.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the spoils taken at Jin'an were divided and bestowed on officers.

literal: On day wuzi, envoys were dispatched at speed to report to the Empress Dowager and to notify every circuit that the army was returning.
idiomatic: On wuzi day envoys were dispatched at speed to report to the Empress Dowager and to notify every circuit that the army was returning.

literal: On day gengyin, he set out from Taiyuan.
idiomatic: On gengyin day he set out from Taiyuan.

literal: On day xinmao, learning that the Jin Emperor had entered Luoyang, he dispatched Langjun Jielide to convey greetings.
idiomatic: On xinmao day, learning that the Jin Emperor had entered Luoyang, he dispatched Langjun Jielide to convey greetings.

literal: On day renchen, he halted at Xihe and reviewed the troops and horses of the surrendered generals Zhao Dejun and his son.
idiomatic: On renchen day he halted at Xihe and reviewed the troops and horses of the surrendered generals Zhao Dejun and his son.

literal: On day wuxu, he halted at Yanmen and distributed the troops under Grand Guardian Sha among the various generals.
idiomatic: On wuxu day he halted at Yanmen and distributed the troops under Grand Guardian Sha among the various generals.

literal: On day gengxu, he visited Yingzhou.
idiomatic: On gengxu day he visited Yingzhou.

literal: On day guichou, the military governors of Tang's Datong, Zhangguo, and Zhenwu circuits came to an audience; they were detained and not sent away.
idiomatic: On guichou day the military governors of Tang's Datong, Zhangguo, and Zhenwu circuits came to an audience; they were detained and not sent away.

literal: The twelfth year of Tianxian.
idiomatic: The twelfth year of Tianxian.

literal: In the first month of spring in the twelfth year, on day bingchen, he halted at Duizikou.
idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the first spring month, on bingchen day, he halted at Duizikou.

literal: Wu Luan, adjutant of Tang's Datong Army, closed the city and refused orders; Cui Tingxun was dispatched to besiege the city.
idiomatic: Wu Luan, adjutant of Tang's Datong Army, closed the city and refused orders; Cui Tingxun was dispatched to besiege the city.

literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor personally campaigned, reached beneath the walls and instructed them; Luan surrendered.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor personally took the field, reached the foot of the walls and instructed them; Luan surrendered.

literal: On day xinyou, demon-arrows were shot north of Yunzhou.
idiomatic: On xinyou day demon-arrows were shot north of Yunzhou.

literal: On day renxu, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to.
idiomatic: On renxu day sacrifice was offered to Heaven and Earth.

literal: On day guihai, the imperial uncle An Duan was dispatched to send the people of the western Xi tribes each back to their native lands.
idiomatic: On guihai day the imperial uncle An Duan was dispatched to send the people of the western Xi tribes each back to their native lands.

literal: On day bingyin, the Empress Dowager dispatched the attendant Shilu to urge him onward; that evening he led light cavalry forward in advance.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the Empress Dowager dispatched the attendant Shilu to urge him onward; that evening he led light cavalry forward in advance.

literal: On day dingchou, Prince Shulü came to meet him at the Luan River and reported his victory at Emperor Taizu's traveling palace.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Shulü came to meet him at the Luan River and reported his victory at Emperor Taizu's traveling palace.

literal: On day wuyin, he attended court before the Empress Dowager and presented precious objects to wish her long life.
idiomatic: On wuyin day he attended court before the Empress Dowager and presented precious objects to wish her long life.

literal: In the second month, on day dinghai, captives taken before the army who had rebelled and entered Youzhou were all executed.
idiomatic: In the second month, on dinghai day, captives taken before the army who had rebelled and entered Youzhou were all executed.

literal: On day renyin, an edict ordered every tribe to rest and restore its soldiers.
idiomatic: On renyin day an edict ordered every tribe to rest and restore its soldiers.

literal: On day guimao, Jin returned Langjun Lage and Secretariat clerk Xiao Daili, whom Tang had seized.
idiomatic: On guimao day Jin returned Langjun Lage and Secretariat clerk Xiao Daili, whom Tang had seized.

literal: In the third month, on day gengshen, Jin sent envoys to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen day, Jin sent envoys with tribute.
